subject: Post-call exec recap & next steps — Redwood + AuroraMed
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Chris Nolan <chris.nolan@auroramed.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call exec recap & next steps — Redwood + AuroraMed

Thanks again for your time today, Chris — good conversation and great context on the clinical triage project. Below is a short executive recap for Dr. Park and your procurement team, plus proposed next steps.

Summary (pain & impact)
- High-level pain: current triage NLP pipeline (vendor X) has inconsistent summary quality for ED triage notes and spikes cost during peak hours.
- Business impact: delayed triage decisions and increasing per-token cost make current approach unsustainable at scale.
- Compliance constraint: data contains PHI; AuroraMed requires SOC 2 Type II and a DPA for any external vendor.

Goals discussed
- Reduce inference unit cost by ~40% for nightly batch/streaming mix.
- Achieve sub-300ms 90th percentile latency for the triage short-summary flow.
- Pilot with a private deployment (VPC) to satisfy PHI controls and KMS integration.

Proposed pilot (8 weeks) — objectives & success criteria
1) Deploy a private Redwood inference stack in AuroraMed VPC (non-prod) with KMS-managed keys.
2) Validate end-to-end RU cost improvements and latency SLOs on representative traffic.
3) Run side-by-side quality evals on the clinical summaries against your current vendor (BLEU/ROUGE + human review).
Success = 40% cost reduction OR hit latency target while maintaining summary quality within agreed thresholds.

Risks & asks
- Security: we will provide SOC 2 Type II and a DPA draft. Please confirm the procurement/security owner who will own the artifacts.
- Timeline: you mentioned an internal target of Q1 2027 — we can structure an accelerated onboarding if procurement cadence allows.

Attachments: AuroraMed_POC_Scope.pdf, Redwood_SOC2_TypeII.pdf

Next steps
- Action (AuroraMed): confirm executive sponsor for pilot (you mentioned Dr. Elena Park) and procurement contact (procurement@auroramed.com)
- Action (Redwood): share SOC2/DPA and a draft POC Master Purchase Agreement (attached).
- Schedule: proposed pilot kickoff calls week of 2026-12-06; please confirm availability.

Happy to iterate on scope for Dr. Park’s review — looping in Aditya and Rishi for pricing & security ops.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0172

--
AuroraMed POC scope attached for your review.

From: Chris Nolan <chris.nolan@auroramed.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@auroramed.com
Date: 2026-11-15T16:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap & next steps — Redwood + AuroraMed

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming a few items from our side:

Executive sponsor
- Dr. Elena Park (CIO) will be the executive sponsor; she wants a 15–20 minute briefing after we validate the pilot plan.

Procurement & timeline
- Procurement will own T&Cs and DPA review: procurement@auroramed.com. Typical cycle ~4–6 weeks for pilot MPA, longer for enterprise terms.
- Target: we are aiming to kick off a pilot in early Jan 2027 (Q1) — procurement + security approval permitting.

Security artifacts & risk items
- Please provide SOC 2 Type II report, DPA template, and a short summary of network architecture for the private deployment (VPC peering, egress controls, KMS integration).
- PHI handling: we will require that logs containing PHI are restricted and retained per our policy — we will share retention requirements once procurement engages.

Pilot interest & next steps
- We remain interested in a pilot. Please send SOC2/DPA and a proposed 8-week SOW (scope + acceptance criteria).
- Also can we get a non-prod demo environment to run a small representative workload next month? That will help Dr. Park feel comfortable before formal sign-off.

Attachments: see procurement@auroramed.com for intake forms (copied).

—Chris
Chris Nolan
Dir, Clinical Informatics | AuroraMed
chris.nolan@auroramed.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Quick internal note / recommended approach:

1) Security pack: we can share a SOC 2 Type II PDF (attached) and our standard DPA. Also include a short topology diagram for private deployment (I will pull from infra). Links: https://redwood.com/security/soc2 and DPA draft (internal link).

2) Pricing & commercial: propose a concessional pilot rate for the 8-week POC (credits + reduced per-token charge) — Rishi, can you draft a pilot pricing sheet and margin impact by EOD Friday? If pilot meets success criteria we will transition to committed capacity (Dedicated) with an enterprise discount.

3) Delivery plan: propose a 2-week onboarding (network & keys), 4-week evaluation, 2-week wrap for acceptance. We should be able to start non-prod demo within 2–3 weeks of procurement intake.

4) Risks: PHI controls and retention need explicit gating from procurement — mark this as an escalation if we do not get retention requirements within the first 7 days of intake.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567 (update deal stage to "Pilot — Contracting").

I will prepare the topology and SOC artifacts tonight.
